card.name: HIV/AIDS context, linking words
card.fires_on: Words and spaces right after or inside HIV/AIDS discussion, such as "-related" after AIDS, "AIDS" in "AIDS-defining", or "of" before AIDS. Also fires on spaces before numbers like CD4 cell counts or infusion times.
